See attached: SOC2_Report_Redwood_2025.pdf (signed), CAIQ_responses_UMB.xlsx (filled with references), and a short retention_summary.pdf (one-pager). Quick notes:
- Customer content: retained until customer deletes or contract termination; we support immediate deletion requests and provide a deletion confirmation audit.

- KMS: customer-managed KMS is supported for Private deployments; Hosted customers can use our managed KMS with an option to rotate keys monthly.
- DPA redlines: I reviewed Redwood's standard DPA — we'll accept typical commercial redlines, but request Umbrella's redline set (we expect IP/data residency asks).
